symptoms_en: Young caterpillars scrape the underside of leaves leaving papery white patches; grown ones eat the whole leaf and damage flowers.
symptoms_hi: छोटी इल्लियाँ पत्तियों की निचली सतह खुरचती हैं जिससे कागज़ जैसे सफ़ेद धब्बे बनते हैं; बड़ी इल्लियाँ पूरी पत्ती और फूल खा जाती हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
symptoms_en.quote: Young larva scrap leaves on ventral surface Grownups defoliate crops

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of chilli
symptoms_en.quote: Newly hatched larvae scrap the green matter in the leaf Affected leaf looks like a papery white structure

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
management_en.quote: Grow castor as trap crop. Collect and destroy egg masses and early instar larvae Set up pheromone traps @ 12/ha.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For caterpillars and other insects: Spray Dashparni Ark or Agniastra @ 7.5 litres + 250 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Grow castor along the border and irrigation channels as a trap crop. Collect and destroy egg masses and young caterpillars. Plough to expose pupae. Set pheromone traps (12 per hectare).
management_hi: मेड़ और सिंचाई नाली के किनारे अरंडी जाल-फसल के रूप में लगाएँ। अंडों के गुच्छे और छोटी इल्लियाँ इकट्ठा करके नष्ट करें। जुताई करके प्यूपा को उजागर करें। फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएँ (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर)।
